CustomField.description: Lookup to a Form_Template_Page_Section__c assigned to this page as 'Section 4'. The formTemplatePageSection LWC maps the slot name 'Section 4' to this lookup (PAGE_SECTION_FIELD_MAP) to resolve and render the assigned section component on the record-page builder. One of 15 numbered section-assignment slots (Section 1 to Section 15) that cap a page at 15 assigned components (#168); component-visibility rules max out at 10 filters, so the 15 lookups are also collapsed into the Has Assigned Sections formula. Managed by the page section configurator — assign and reorder sections there rather than editing these lookups directly. Delete constraint Set Null.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This holds the section component placed in slot 4 of this page; the page section configurator sets and reorders these slots for you. A page supports up to 15 numbered section slots (Section 1 to Section 15) — assign and arrange them in the configurator rather than editing these lookups by hand.
CustomField.label: Form Component Section (4)
